name: Pieter van der Merwe
bio:
Pieter van der Merwe's journey into motorsport marketing began unconventionally, with a background in rugby and a keen interest in the engineering aspects of Formula 1. After completing a degree in Marketing, Pieter started his career at a local advertising firm before transitioning into the motorsport world. He initially worked on grassroots racing events before landing a role with AF Corse.

Pieter's approach to marketing is rooted in a deep understanding of both the technical and emotional sides of racing. He believes in creating authentic connections with fans and sponsors alike, and his background gives him a unique ability to translate complex technical details into engaging stories. He's known for his strategic thinking and creative campaign ideas that maximize brand exposure and drive fan engagement.

What sets Pieter apart is his relentless drive and commitment to excellence. He is always seeking innovative ways to elevate AF Corse's marketing efforts. He is also unafraid to challenge conventional thinking, consistently pushing boundaries to deliver impactful results.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly cropped with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Pieter is a man of medium build with a friendly face and a perpetual hint of a smile.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with marketing ideas.
Has a habit of tapping his pen when deep in thought.
Prefers to conduct meetings standing up to encourage efficiency.
